_method_note: Network access to info.gouv.fr, entreprises.gouv.fr, usinenouvelle.com, world-nuclear-news.org etc. was blocked in this session (proxy 403). All figures come from web-search result extracts only; NO page was opened directly. 'quote' fields are search-engine extracts of the cited page and may be truncated, translated or slightly reworded. Every quote must be re-checked against the live page before publication.

call_totals.label: Phase 2 ('temps 2') first two laureates: Calogena + Jimmy — official figure is total investment mobilised, not State aid
call_totals.quote: Calogena et Jimmy : les 2 premiers lauréats du temps 2 du dispositif « réacteurs nucléaires innovants » ... plus de 180 M€ d'investissement mobilisés (search extract; 180M = public + private, not State aid)

projects.quote: soutien public de 10 millions d'euros (search extract; also Sfen 'contribution publique de 10 M€')
projects.notes: XAMR (40 MWe molten-salt fast reactor) is the project announced in June 2023 with CEA as partner; mapping to 'NAAREA FCE 2030' is by partners (CEA + Naarea), not by an official label. Company press release on naarea.fr (url: https://www.naarea.fr/france-2030-naarea-accelere-dans-le-nucleaire-durable-et-poursuit-son-developpement-ambitieux) not readable here. Naarea later entered receivership (2025); takeover bid by Poland's Eneris reported — dates differ by source. No official per-project figure found; only group total 24.9M.

projects.aid_type: grant (subvention); figure reportedly includes ~5M earmarked for CEA
projects.quote: une première aide de 19 millions d'euros de l'État, dont 5 millions destinés au CEA (search extract of CNDP compte rendu)
projects.notes: CONTRADICTORY figures: 19M (CNDP compte rendu; HCTISN newcleo slide 2 Dec 2025 '19 M€ de subvention de l'Etat / France 2030 Phase 1'); 19.8M 'dont 5M CEA' (newcleo answers to citizen group, debatpublic.fr Apr 2026; Sortir du nucléaire); 9.8M 'subvention phase 1' (newcleo CNDP presentation 10 June 2026); ~15M (Le Figaro via blog); ~20M (Reuters). Plausible reading 9.8-14.8M to newcleo + 5M CEA, but not confirmed. 10M (Naarea)+19M exceeds the official 24.9M group total, so the 24.9M probably excludes the CEA share. newcleo was NOT retained for phase 2 (announced by newcleo 17 July 2026; SGPI said it exceeded programme scope).

projects.quote: Jimmy reçoit 32 millions d'euros de France 2030 pour industrialiser sa chaudière nucléaire
projects.notes: Corroborated by Jimmy's own press release 'Nucléaire : l'Etat injecte 32 millions d'euros dans Jimmy' (https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/635111d6ca87d1b2c29ffe52/65b0da94e2a00f988236aac6_CP%20-%20France%202030_VF.pdf) and AFP.

projects.aid_type: grant (subvention); separately, State equity via ADEME Investissement (amount not disclosed separately)
projects.quote: la start-up Jimmy a annoncé mardi avoir sécurisé 80 millions d'euros, dont 40 millions de la 2e phase du programme d'investissements "réacteurs innovants" de France 2030
projects.notes: Other 40M is equity led by Crédit Mutuel Impact with ADEME Investissement (Crédit Mutuel press release). Phase 1 + phase 2 grants = 72M.

projects.quote: Calogena ... avait précédemment obtenu 5,2 millions d'euros de subventions (AFP, search extract)
projects.notes: Also reported by Usine Nouvelle. No official per-project figure found.

projects.aid_type: aid/subvention (AFP says 'aides'); separately State equity via Banque des Territoires and Bpifrance Deep Tech 2030 fund (amounts not separated)
projects.quote: le soutien renforcé de France 2030 avec une aide de 48 M€ annoncé à l'occasion du Sommet sur l'Energie Nucléaire le 10 mars dernier
projects.notes: Same figure in AFP ('Calogena (groupe Gorgé) reçoit 48 millions d'euros d'aides') and Calogena PDF https://www.calogena.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/AVECUN1.pdf. Funds the avant-projet détaillé (APD). Total financing 'près de 100 M€' includes equity (SNEF, Banque des Territoires, Bpifrance). One unverified site claims a €40M EU Innovation Fund grant — not confirmed.

projects.quote: awarded a € 10m grant by BPI France
projects.notes: Company press release; corroborated by Le Journal des Entreprises 'Renaissance Fusion décroche une subvention de 10 millions d'euros dans le cadre de France 2030'. Also receives CEA technical support (amount not stated). 'RF01' label not found in sources — mapped by partners.

projects.aid_type: grant (Bpifrance / France 2030), reportedly conditional on matching private funds
projects.quote: Sous réserve qu'elle arrive à lever l'équivalent en fonds privés, Hexana a décroché une subvention de 10 millions d'euros de France 2030
projects.notes: Corroborated by CFNews/Dealroom: €25M round = 15M equity + 10M Bpifrance France 2030 subsidy. No company/official primary source read.

projects.lead: Blue Capsule (consortium with Egis Nucléaire and CEA)
projects.quote: bénéficiant ainsi d'une subvention pouvant aller jusqu'à 10M€
projects.notes: Partner (Egis) press release; amount is a maximum ('pouvant aller jusqu'à'). Reactor is a 150 MWth high-temperature sodium-pool / air-cooled design (not molten salt).

projects.quote: [first round] 10 millions d'euros de fonds propres privés et 10 millions d'euros de subventions non dilutives France 2030 (search extract)
projects.notes: No official or company figure for the phase-1 grant found. Conflicting trade-press: Le Journal des Entreprises 10M France 2030 grants (first round, early 2026); Usine Nouvelle says the 2026 €17M round includes '7,5 millions d'euros de subventions de France 2030' (https://www.usinenouvelle.com/energie/nucleaire/smr/edf-rentre-au-capital-de-la-start-up-francaise-francaise-otrera-qui-securise-17-millions-deuros-supplementaires-pour-son-projet-de-smr-refroidi-au-sodium.YEDD775XLVFNREBF5FOUBG5KKU.html). These may be tranches of the same grant. Left null deliberately. Note: published per-project figures for the Nov-2023 batch (32+10+10+10+5.2) sum to 67.2M vs 77.2M official — the difference is NOT a sourced Otrera figure.

projects.quote: Chaque consortium se voit attribuer 10 M€ de subvention par l'Etat français
projects.notes: Joint Stellaria/Thorizon/Orano press release (also on orano.group). Stellaria's July 2025 €23M raise described as complementing 'le financement non dilutif de 10 millions d'euros'.

projects.lead: Thorizon (consortium with Orano and CEA, plus academic partners)
projects.quote: Chaque consortium se voit attribuer 10 M€ de subvention par l'Etat français
projects.notes: Same joint press release as Stellaria; also https://www.orano.group/en/news/news-group/2024/march/france-2030-the-two-startups-stellaria-and-thorizon-working-in-consortium-with-orano-selected-as-winners-of-the-call-for-projects-to-develop-molten-salt-reactors . Thorizon separately got €10M EU grant (ZILT, Netherlands) — not France 2030.

projects.project: TARANIS (fusion; listed in projects.txt but not in the caller's reactor list)
projects.quote: subvention de 3,5 millions d'euros de l'appel à projets France 2030 (search extract)
projects.notes: One of the 11 AAP phase-1 laureates (3rd batch). Usine Nouvelle: 3.5M France 2030 + 15M Thales = 18.5M budget. Note: 10+10+3.5 = 23.5M vs 27.8M official batch total — gap unexplained (perhaps CEA support or different perimeter); do not allocate.

projects.aid_type: direct grant (State aid approved by European Commission under RDI framework); separate from the AAP
projects.quote: Nuward ... a annoncé l'approbation de la Commission européenne de l'aide d'état de 300 millions d'euros
projects.notes: EC: 'The aid will take the form of a direct grant that will cover the R&D project until 2027' (Euronuclear/EC summaries). Earlier €50M approved Dec 2022 under the 2020-2022 Plan de relance (not France 2030). NEI describes the 300M as 'via the France 2030 investment initiative'; EC press release (ec.europa.eu) not read directly. France 2030 is often quoted as earmarking 500M for Nuward/SMR — envelope, not a grant. Project since redesigned (EDF reorientation 2024).
